integrated_answer.claim: Account-nested routes expose index/create/update/destroy. Index returns a bare array; create/update return a record; destroy returns empty OK. Create, list/search, and update/destroy lookup traverse Current.account.canned_responses; permitted mutation fields are short_code/content. Model requires content/short_code/account and short_code uniqueness within account.

Search deletes NUL bytes, binds case-insensitive substring matching across short_code/content, then orders descending by sanitized CASE values: short-code prefix 1, short-code substring .5, content substring .2. SQL-value sanitization does not escape LIKE wildcards.

The server/client shapes reconcile: cannedResponse overrides inherited payload extraction with response.data and marshalling with {data:rows}. Both cache-hit marshalling and refetch extraction dispatch these hooks; generic defaults establish no shape defect. Account-scoped URLs derive from the current route; dataManager reselects when its account differs. Network reads bypass cache; cached reads validate keys, refetch empty/stale data, and fall back after initialization failure.

Existing request specs assert CRUD/authentication, direct array shape, search ranking and NUL removal. Cache specs assert account switching, cold/warm/stale reads, bare-array parity and unavailable-IndexedDB fallback using test doubles. These are source assertions, not passing executions.

unresolved_dependencies: Authorization-helper, DataManager/cache-invalidation internals and concurrent route changes remain outside inspected content; defined cross-role questions resolved.
findings_or_risks: No demonstrated contract defect. Existing request specs do not establish cross-account rejection; cache specs use doubles rather than importing the canned-response singleton.
